name: Divine Heart Machina
original_name: ディバインハート マキナ
source: A transforming heroine who secretly fights against Millennium, a secret organization that plans to rule over the world. Her true identity is a black-haired beautiful girl with a dignified atmosphere and an indomitable passion. In her previous work, she defeated Mido, the murderer of Makina's father and her arch-nemesis. She has destroyed many of the organization's branches, but she is finally captured by the enemies this time. While she is being captured, Ark which is her source power for transformation is being bombarded with dark energy of degradation...
